jobs.name: p5
jobs.prompt: Medieval winter night, looking down a snowy rutted dirt road to a river ford. In the middle distance the road runs into the black river: a line of flat stepping stones across the shallows, ice along both edges. On the near bank of the ford stand three of them, each a crude open cage of black iron bars on top of a short black iron post, a medieval fire basket with no glass, no lantern, no street lamp, burning with a cold pale blue flame, their blue light glittering on the water as short carved strokes. In the middle of the river a fourth pale blue flame hangs in the empty air just above the water, nothing visible holding it, rings carved on the water beneath it. Bare black winter trees on both sides frame the road. On the road in the middle ground a broken wooden cart lies on its side, one wheel in the air. In the ditches on both sides of the road stand many drowned dead: barefoot peasants in ragged soaked medieval tunics and shifts, no hats, long wet hair hanging with river weed, gaunt, standing still with slack arms, every face turned toward the road, irregular spacing, varied heights and stances, some turned, some half in shadow. Snow on the banks left as bare pale paper. The only color is the cold pale blue of the iron fire baskets; everything else is black and deep blue-black ink and pale snow.

jobs.name: p6
jobs.prompt: Medieval dusk, the last light: a deep indigo sky over a thin dull rose band along the horizon. At left, a small camp beside a rutted dirt road: a campfire burning high, its flames carved as bold ember orange and gold shapes, a log, a bedroll unrolled with a folded blanket on it, a pack. One lone traveler in a long plain dark wool cloak with a deep hood up, seen from behind, sits on the log by the fire reading a folded letter, a small flask on a cord at the wrist; no weapon. Far up the road on the dark hills, the small warm lamps of a village, one lamp higher than the rest. At right, the ground slopes down out of the firelight into cold dark shadow to a wide river smooth as a mirror, flat stones at its edge, holding the last light of the sky. Low through the dark trees upstream by the water, three tiny points of cold pale blue light, unevenly spaced. The warm light is only the fire and the far lamps; everything else is black, deep blue-black ink and the dull rose of the sky.

jobs.name: p7
jobs.prompt: Night. Seen from behind and slightly to the left, a hooded traveler in a long dark wool cloak kneels on flat wet stones at the very edge of a black river, back to us, leaning over the water, the face entirely hidden inside the deep hood, a gloved hand holding a small flask under the surface, rings spreading from it. To the right, out over the water, a small crude cage of black iron bars with no glass and no handle, holding a cold pale blue flame, hangs in the empty air a hand's breadth above the water at the height of the hood; nothing holds it, its glare too bright to see what is above it. The traveler's dark hooded reflection lies in the black water below. The cold blue light glitters on the water as short carved strokes and washes along the edge of the hood. The only color is the cold pale blue of the flame; everything else is black and deep blue-black ink.
